note: EXAMPLE: building invented to show the tool with the case in buildings.md ("Example case"): 8 single-phase apartments of 7 kVA, collective three-phase supply, phase split from ELEC-EDI-10 and 8.5 kVA of common services. Only apartment 4A (the farthest) has its interior surveyed; for the other seven only the panel and its sub-main are entered. The cross-section of each sub-main comes from `electricidad size --circuit submain` (Ib 31.6 A; 1 % on the sub-main, 771).
